2117320729817719086.content_en:
Advantages of overseas FX

•The margin required is 1/40 of a domestic account, so leftover money can go into stocks or spot crypto; even if you lose at FX in the worst case, you can just win with stocks or spot crypto
•You can hold multiple accounts, so you can split your money into a trading account and a fund-management account and trade with zero-cut at your back (no worry of losing big because a stop-loss slipped)
•No margin calls (追証)
•Spreads on the highly volatile GOLD are narrower than in domestic FX (scalping USD/JPY for 10 pips every day in domestic FX is hard)

Disadvantages of overseas FX

•Withdrawal refusals exist, so choosing a broker is extremely important (right now HFM and XS are the top two → which brokers are good changes depending on the environment)
•Because of the payment-agency (収納代行) problem, you need to deposit and withdraw using crypto

Conclusion→
Where FX ends up is scalping USD/JPY in domestic FX, but since the difficulty of winning is high, overseas FX GOLD is also one option.
Just pick whichever you like.
2117320729817719086.content_original:
海外FXのメリット

•証拠金が国内口座の40分の1で良いので、
余ったお金を株や仮想通貨の現物に回せる、最悪FXで負けても株や仮想通貨の現物で勝てば良い
•口座を複数持てるため、お金をトレード用と資金管理用の口座に分けて、ゼロカットを背にトレードできる（損切りが滑って大きく負ける心配がない）
•追証がない
•ボラティリティの高いGOLDのスプレッドが国内FXより狭い（国内FXのドル円スキャで毎日10pips抜くのは難易度が高い）

海外FXのデメリット

•出金拒否があるので業者選びが超重要（今だとHFMとXSの2強→環境により良い業者は変化する）
•収納代行の問題があるため仮想通貨で入出金をする必要がある

結論→
FXの行きつく先は国内FXでドル円のスキャルピングだが、勝つ難易度が高いため、海外FXのGOLDも選択肢のひとつ。
好きな方を選択すれば良い。

2118149996386369672.content_en:
XS / Exness > Lighter / Variational >>> Hyperliquid > other perp DEXs / overseas exchanges >>>>>>> domestic exchanges

This is really the case if you only consider trading costs.

However, for a limited period, Variational, whose TGE is planned for year-end, has an airdrop expected value of 1P = $29 ~ $48.

So in terms of priority up to year-end:

Variational >>>>>>>>> XS / Exness > Lighter ...

Before starting I thought it was too late to begin now,

but the value of an airdrop per point is the same for early and late entrants,

and since I'm going to trade anyway, lower trading costs are better, so my conclusion is that right now Variational is the only choice.
2118149996386369672.content_original:
XS / Exness > Lighter / Variational >>> Hyperliquid >その他PerpDEX / 海外取引所 >>>>>>> 国内取引所

取引コストだけを考えたらこれはマジ

ただ、期間限定でいえば年末にTGE予定の Variational に関して 1P = $29 ~ $48 エアドロ期待値があるから

年末までの優先順位でいくと

Variational >>>>>>>>> XS / Exness > Lighter ・・・

今からだと遅いと始める前は思っていたけど

ポイントに対するエアドロップの価値は先行組でも後発組でも変わらないし

どうせトレードするなら取引コストは安いに越した事はないので結論、今は Variational 一択だと思います

2119368573600825717.content_en:
【Overseas FX Deposit/Withdrawal Issue】
The first responses from each company have arrived.

This time #XMTrading #XS #VantageTrading #TitanFX #Ultima responded.

All of the brokers' responses came not from the Japan staff but from head-office executive level.

To state the result as of now, all brokers gave the same answer: the view is that bank deposits and withdrawals are unlikely to all disappear suddenly from December.

Of course, card deposits will also continue to be usable.

Each company is meeting closely with its payment agents too, and has already secured multiple deposit/withdrawal lines by connecting with several companies rather than a single exclusive one.

However, I can't deny that deposits/withdrawals may become slightly more complicated.

They also said they will respond flexibly to unforeseen circumstances and will be more conscious than ever about users' deposits and withdrawals. (Of course, withdrawal suspensions for terms violations are a separate matter; this time it's about responding to the amended law.)

Some brokers have already acquired a Japanese securities company, but unless the broker launches it, I can't say; I'll just add at the end that all brokers are doing quite a lot of preparation.

We will receive reports whenever there is progress.

H〇M and EX〇〇〇S ended their partnership earlier, so I didn't ask them this time, but from now on I will check with them too in order to compile the information!
2119368573600825717.content_original:
【海外FX入出金問題】
各社から1回目の回答がきました。

今回 #XMTrading #XS #VantageTrading #TitanFX #Ultima にご回答頂きました。

どのブローカーも日本担当ではなく本部役員クラスからの回答になります。

現時点で結果から言いますと、全ブローカー同じ回答で12月からいきなり銀行入出金が全て無くなる事はないだろうという見解です。

もちろんカード入金も変わらず使えます。

各社代行業者とも密にミーティングを行なっており、独占ではなく数社と繋がることで複数の入出金ラインを確保済みだということです。

ただ少しだけ入出金時に複雑になる可能性は否めません。

また不慮の事態には臨機応変に対応し、ユーザーの入出金に関しては今まで以上に意識をしていくと言う事です。（もちろん規約違反の出金停止などは別話で、今回は改正された法律への対応の話です。）

中には既に日本の証券会社を買収済のブローカーもありましたが、そちらはブローカーからローンチされない限り私からは言えませんが全ブローカーかなり対策してるとだけ最後につけ加えて置きます。
